# Code of Conduct

## Our commitment

I want these projects and their discussions to be welcoming, constructive, and useful to people with different backgrounds and experience levels.

## Expected behavior

- Be respectful and assume good faith where reasonable.
- Critique ideas and code without attacking people.
- Offer actionable feedback and explain disagreements clearly.
- Respect boundaries, privacy, and different levels of experience.
- Keep discussions relevant and help make technical spaces easier to participate in.

## Unacceptable behavior

Harassment, personal attacks, discriminatory language, doxxing, threats, deliberate intimidation, and persistent disruptive behavior are not welcome.

## Enforcement

If behavior makes a project space unsafe or unproductive, it may be moderated, content may be removed, or participation may be restricted. To report a concern privately, use the contact method listed in the relevant repository or GitHub profile.

This code of conduct applies to project issues, pull requests, discussions, and other project spaces.
